text:
maya: Quick sync  We need a dry-run plan for analyst briefings tomorrow. Main asks: quotes locked, perf slides ready, and one Q&A owner per briefing.

zoe: I can own the Q&A doc and intake for follow-ups. Will make an FAQ sheet.

sam: Benchmarks team: perf slide deck almost done. Need to confirm r100 95th percentile and cost-per-token delta vs baseline.

leo: Infra said r100 run completes in ~2.5h. If delayed, we use r50 with clear note.

elaine: Press contacts list updated here: https://drive.redwood/press/launch-v2/contacts. Adding two APAC analysts per request.

press-bot: Embargo reminder: 2026-04-08T16:00Z (set at 1797504400).

maya: Timeline for tomorrow: 09:00 PT dry run w/ spokes, 11:00 PT analyst briefing batch 1, 13:00 PT batch 2. Final publish 16:00 PT.

zoe: FAQ will include: product scope, security/compliance, pricing model, and which results are internal-only.

sam: For quotes, please approve one-line and two-paragraph variants. Templates below:
```
One-line: \"Redwood Inference reduces tail latency and stabilizes costs for teams running production LLMs.\"
Two-paragraph: \"Our runtime combines optimized kernels, prefix caching, and workload-aware batching to reduce latency variance. That means predictable performance across hosted and private deployments, with lower unit costs.\"
```

elaine: Legal note: avoid earnings-like language. Ask: can we include % improvement numbers in analyst slides?

leo: Engineering ok to share relative deltas (e.g., \"~30% lower median latency vs baseline\") but not absolute customer identifiers.

maya: Good. Who will do live demo during briefings? Sam + Leo?

sam: I can run the demo flow; Leo will be on standby for infra questions.

zoe: I'll host the calendar invites and include press kit link + embargo note. Invite template: short agenda, demo link, one-page FAQ, and data appendix.

press-bot: Calendar invites created: 11:00 PT (Analyst batch A), 13:00 PT (Analyst batch B). Reservation ids: A-7782, B-7783.

elaine: If an analyst requests raw benchmarking artifacts, route to solutions-eng and require NDA.

maya: Checklist now: quotes (elaine/legal), deck (sam), perf (leo/infra), FAQ (zoe), invites (zoe). Target lock times: quotes by 08:00 PT, deck by 09:30 PT, perf numbers by 09:00 PT.

sam: Noted 44d will push updated slides to drive and ping when done.

leo: Infra pinged at 1797504550; will update here with run completion or fallback.

press-bot: Live status: quotes (pending), deck (in progress), perf (running), invites (done).

maya: Thanks team. If anything slips, we move the affected analysts to the afternoon batch and notify PR contacts. Reconnect here at 08:30 PT for final go/no-go.

zoe: Copy that. I'll prep the FAQ and import previous briefing notes to speed edits.

elaine: I'll confirm legal clearance for the one-line quote by 08:00 PT.

sam: Slide update pushed at 1797504980.

leo: Perf run finished at 1797505005. r100 95th = 182ms, median = 42ms. Sharing appendix link: https://drive.redwood/press/launch-v2/perf-appendix.

maya: Great. Locking quotes now and distributing to spokes for dry run. Good job everyone.
